note: Keys and example values are extracted from the captured files named per family; a field this lane did not observe is recorded as null with a note rather than guessed. Field names are the source's own spelling (including the source's typos, e.g. KSHSAA 'MailingAdress').
contract_scope: only public professional school/sport-role contacts are represented here: school name, role, published professional name, published professional email. No athlete contact, personal email, personal phone or home address is captured; where a source exposes such columns they are named in `deliberately_not_collected` and are not read.

kshsaa_directory_json.transport: GET, JSON array; one request per letter a-z covers the whole state
kshsaa_directory_json.coach_fields_note: no per-sport coach field exists in the payload; a detail endpoint was probed and 404s
kshsaa_directory_json.deliberately_not_collected_reason: personal mobile numbers; the contract collects only published school/sport-role contacts, so these columns are never read into any artifact of this lane

ihsa_staff2_json.transport: GET, JSON; one request per school
envelope: Activities - Head Coaches, Advisers, and Directors
Non-Competitive Activities - Head Coaches, Advisers, and Directors
ihsa_staff2_json.coach_field_note: coach roles appear in the same staff list; the XC head coach is a row whose DefaultTitle names the sport

email_endpoint.cost: one extra request per person whose HasEmail is true

wiaawi_school_directory_html.transport: GET HTML, one request per school; school list at /Directory/School/List

stable_identifier.where: query parameter and the school-list links

wiaawi_school_directory_html.email_encoding: addresses are rendered inside Cloudflare email-protection blobs; the decoded value is the real address
wiaawi_school_directory_html.email_decoded_example_owner: Alex Larson (the Athletic Director row above)
wiaawi_school_directory_html.sport_discovery: the set of sport rows is itself the school's offering list, so XC/TF presence is directly observable

myohsaa_sports_information_html.transport: GET HTML; two pages per school (school list -> school id)
myohsaa_sports_information_html.sport_matrix_note: one row per sport; the boys' and girls' head coaches are separate columns, so side is explicit
myohsaa_sports_information_html.email_encoding: addresses are mailto: hrefs on the coach's name anchor
myohsaa_sports_information_html.email_example_owner: the first coach anchor on the Track & Field page

nsaa_direxportscreen_html.transport: POST form field `school=<name>`; one request per school, HTML response

stable_identifier.where: the form's own school selector; no numeric id is published

nsaa_direxportscreen_html.email_note: NSAA publishes no email field at all in this view; the absence is by design, not a parse failure
nsaa_direxportscreen_html.coach_naming: each sport's coach is a labelled row, e.g. a Boys Cross Country row next to the AD row

ndhsaa_school_html.transport: GET HTML; school list at ndhsaa.com/schools

blocks.administration: role -> name rows (Superintendent / Principal / Athletic Director)

ndhsaa_school_html.coach_cell_note: a single cell may carry several names, comma separated

fpsports_school_directory_html.transport: GET HTML; the whole state directory is served in one (CT/ME) or a few (RI) pages

stable_identifier.where: tables are positional; the school name is the block heading, not a key

row_semantics: phone (tel:, often the school main line, often empty)
fpsports_school_directory_html.email_note: no email column exists in this template (0 mailto across all three captures)

mshsl_school_html.transport: GET HTML; school index at mshsl.org/schools

ad_block.example_line: Administration Activities Director: Scott Buntje <a href="tel:320-845-5...">
ad_block.email_note: the page publishes an Activities-Director tel: number but no email; 0 real addresses in all three captures

mshsl_school_html.coach_note: no sport-scoped coach rows on the school page

row_semantics: school name with classification in parentheses
address lines follow in sibling rows
ghsa_school_directory_html.contact_note: the captured directory carries 1 mailto in total and no named person column

blocks.conference_administrators: 78 rows with 74 mailto - conference-level admin, not a school AD

nchsaa_schools_html.contact_scope_warning: the only name+email block is conference-level; it must not be written into a school-scoped AD column

wiaa_finalforms_state_schools_html.transport: GET HTML, paginated (51 pages observed for the state)
wiaa_finalforms_state_schools_html.person_note: no named person on the page; each school also renders one Cloudflare-protected 'Contact Info' email whose ROLE IS NOT LABELLED, so it cannot be attributed to an AD or a coach and is therefore not claimed as an AD email
wiaa_finalforms_state_schools_html.sport_list_note: the per-school sport list makes XC/TF offering observable without a coach name

mpssaa_search_json.transport: GET JSON search, one request per query term
mpssaa_search_json.result_note: results mix `type: school` (identity, with a school-directory URL) and `type: sport` (committee pages whose excerpt text embeds names and phone numbers); the sport excerpts are the association's own published committee contacts, they are not school ADs

milesplit_coach_pages.status: OWNED BY ANOTHER LANE (research/sources/milesplit-national); cited here, not re-measured
milesplit_coach_pages.role_in_this_lane: VALIDATION_SOURCE: cross-check a coach name the association directory publishes

bound_directory_html.field_names_note: not observed by this lane; the fields quoted in tools/validation-retractions.json came from the prior study's browser session

cloudflare_challenges.reason: 403 / JS challenge / empty 202 to this client; not bypassed by design
